text:
Ana: Quick FYI — compiling a lightweight "security intake handbook" for marketplace HW+SI launches. Goal: a one-pager for partners outlining SOC/pen/questionnaire/artifact flow. Need owners for presign + redaction rules. @Devon @Priya @Ben
Devon: Love it. Can we include an "emergency contact" for pen test findings? Also need scope mapping doc from SI.
Priya: I can draft the SI section (credentials, certs, allowed attachments). MD in repo ok? or a checklist PDF?
Ana: MD in the repo + a short slide. Keep consumable. Key items: required artifacts (SOC2 Type II, latest pen report, vendor questionnaire), redaction guidance, presign TTL, upload endpoints, encryption/KMS notes.
Ben: Presign TTL update — infra default is 24h now. Example presign command:
asset-bot: `/presign create --bucket marketplace-evidence --ttl 24h --notify @Ana`
Devon: For HW partners add firmware attestation + chain-of-custody scanned docs requirement.
Priya: SI integration checklist to include: test accounts, dummy-data policy, credential rotation schedule, contact alias for escalation.
Ana: Who can own final review & publishing to partner portal? Ideally before Mon EOD. @Ben?
Ben: I can take review. I'll update the repo and ping marketing for portal upload.
Devon: Pen test scheduling: require test window >= 5 days and full scope doc 7 days prior — include in handbook.
Priya: Redaction examples — replace PII with {{REDACTED}} and avoid screenshots with keys. Quick redaction snippet:
```bash
# example redaction
sed -E 's/([A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,})/{{REDACTED_EMAIL}}/g' artifact.pdf
```
Ana: Also add retention notes: review artifacts stored 90 days; compliance backups 365 days. Who owns long-term retention ops?
Ben: Infra manages retention lifecycle, I'll confirm the policy ID and post it in the PR.
asset-bot: presign created by Ben for /partners/acme/2026-03-handbook.pdf (ttl 24h) :white_check_mark:
Ana: Sweet. I'll assemble draft by EOD and open a PR. Thanks all :raised_hands:
Devon: :thumbsup:
